change.before: Tool text in this summary input has a separate 2,000-character cap.
change.after: For completed assistant tool results in this summary input, only the serialized output content is truncated when it exceeds 2,000 UTF-16 code units: the serializer keeps the first 2,000 units using JavaScript `slice(0, 2000)` and appends `\n[truncated]`, so the marked result is longer than 2,000 units. This output truncation does not cap tool arguments or error messages, and is not a universal cap on all model-visible tool content.
change.scope: Only the truncation sentence is replaced; every other original byte is preserved.
